metadata.description: Fund-type replay: the main backtest's trades (same signals, entry/exit dates and daily mark-to-market paths) re-sized and re-costed under each profile's economics. Leverage labels are descriptive: the replay does not model concurrency limits or margin, and max_gross_leverage reports the peak gross exposure actually run.

field_notes.drawdowns: all drawdown fields are <= 0, relative to the running peak; the starting capital counts as the first peak
field_notes.profit_factor: sum of winning trades / |sum of losing trades|; null when there is no losing trade (infinite) or no trade at all
